scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:run
scripts.cf-typecheck: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/wrangler.log wrangler types --include-env=false --check worker-runtime.d.ts && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/wrangler.log wrangler types --include-runtime=false --check worker-configuration.d.ts && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/wrangler.log wrangler types --config wrangler.statsig.jsonc --env-interface StatsigEnv --include-runtime=false --check worker-statsig-configuration.d.ts
scripts.cf-typegen: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/wrangler.log wrangler types --include-env=false worker-runtime.d.ts && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/wrangler.log wrangler types --include-runtime=false worker-configuration.d.ts && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/wrangler.log wrangler types --config wrangler.statsig.jsonc --env-interface StatsigEnv --include-runtime=false worker-statsig-configuration.d.ts
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.statsig.jsonc --env="" && wrangler deploy
scripts.typecheck: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/wrangler.log react-router typegen && pnpm run cf-typecheck && tsc --project tsconfig.json && tsc --project workers/app/tsconfig.json && tsc --project workers/statsig/tsconfig.json
